description: This is a Python test script for verifying that network interfaces associated with bridges 'brlan0' and 'brlan1' are present and active (up). It executes system commands to retrieve interface names and their statuses, and validates the expected conditions as part of an automated testing framework.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with target IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Checks if the required module ('sysutil') is successfully loaded.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing commands.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the specified test command and captures the result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result status of the test execution.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed output from the executed command.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the overall test result status ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE').

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the loaded test module after completion.

calls:
brctl show | grep brlan1 | awk '{ print $NF }' | tr "
" " "

brctl show | grep brlan0 | awk '{ print $NF }' | tr "
" " "

ip a show %s up | grep -w "state UP" | tr "
" " "
